'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Lebanon pager explosions]]
***The death toll from yesterday's [[pager]] [[explosion]]s in [[Lebanon]], targeting [[Hezbollah]]'s communication network, increases to twelve, including four [[Health professional|healthcare workers]] and two children, with more than 2,800 others injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/18/israels-war-on-gaza-live-thousands-injured-in-lebanon-pager-explosions?update=3186514 (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-israel-exploding-pagers-hezbollah-syria-ce6af3c2e6de0a0dddfae48634278288 (AP)]
***[[Walkie-talkie]]s and other electronic devices continue to explode across Lebanon, including at a [[funeral]] in [[Baalbek]] for three Hezbollah members and a boy who were killed in yesterday's explosions. At least 20 people are killed and more than 450 others are injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/18/israels-war-on-gaza-live-thousands-injured-in-lebanon-pager-explosions?update=3187804 (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-israel-exploding-pagers-hezbollah-syria-ce6af3c2e6de0a0dddfae48634278288 (AP)]
***Several home [[solar energy]] systems explode in [[Beirut]], Lebanon. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/lebanons-official-news-agency-reports-home-solar-energy-113809042 (ABC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli occupation of the West Bank]]
***The [[United Nations General Assembly]] votes 124–14 with 43 [[abstention]]s to demand that [[Israel]] end its unlawful presence in the [[occupied Palestinian territories]] within the next 12 months. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-demand-israel-end-unlawful-presence-palestinian-territories-within-12-months-2024-09-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Toropets depot explosions]]
****A [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] weapons depot in [[Toropets]], [[Tver Oblast]], causes [[Toropets depot explosions|an explosion]] large enough to be detected as an earthquake by monitoring stations. Local residents are told to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] and schools in the region are closed. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/sep/18/ukraine-drone-attack-on-russian-arms-depot-toropets (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Government of Mexico|Mexican]] [[Secretariat of National Defense|Secretary of Defense]] [[Luis Cresencio Sandoval]] announces that at least 30 people have been killed since September 9 during [[shootout]]s between rival factions of the [[Sinaloa Cartel]] in [[Sinaloa]], Mexico. [[President of Mexico|Mexican President]] [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] partially blames the [[United States]] for the surge in violence. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-culiacan-violence-sinaloa-cartel-el-mayo-chapo-e980e88d2d6883b2fa5e8180a113a08b (AP)] [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-sinaloa-cartel-violence-culiacan-lopez-obrador-671dd018e57d9bea1e3f8b58c866939b (AP 2)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 South American wildfires]]
**[[2024 Peru wildfires]]
***[[President of Peru]] [[Dina Boluarte]] issues a [[state of emergency]] for the [[regions of Peru|departments]] of [[Amazonas (Peruvian department)|Amazonas]], [[Department of San Martín|San Martín]], and [[Department of Ucayali|Ucayali]], which have been significantly impacted by [[wildfire]]s that have killed at least sixteen people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-declares-state-emergency-regions-scorched-by-forest-fires-2024-09-18/ (Reuters)]

**Twelve people are arrested on suspicion of [[arson]] resulting in widespread wildfires in [[North Region, Portugal|Northern]] and [[Central Region, Portugal|Central]] [[Portugal]] that have killed at least seven people.  [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/beset-by-wildfires-portugal-gets-help-spain-morocco-2024-09-18/ (Reuters)]
